scope: one fixed-model, fixed-context, fixed-mask, fixed-length conditional family
reviewed_correspondence: Model::factors uses target XOR fixed mask bit, context and position; it does not consume the target prefix.
Forecast retains an immutable model; Likelihood multiplies the same fixed-bank factors.
Score learning updates each position once per row, so updates to earlier positions do not alter later factors.
The shared length mass and unchanged other-bit factors do not supply within-body dependencies.
proof_boundary: Manual source correspondence review, not a machine-checked Rust translation. No restriction is inferred for mixtures, other contexts or model families. Normalization and ownership laws remain valid.
extension: Existing CausalCoding.Kernel admits target-prefix state. Exact kernel transport and a normalized strictly positive correlated witness prove semantic inclusion and strictness, not learnability, efficiency or a native implementation.
